entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A nomadic, mainly white-aligned humanoid race native to Zendikar who hunt mikunga and rely on lines, ropes and hooks as a sign of connection.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane whose native kor wander its Roil-churned winds, and which may be the origin world of Dominaria's kor.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane with its own kor, such as the en-Kor and il-Kor.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: A plane where the kor were last seen, alongside Dal and Vec, facing the evincar.

entities.name: Mikunga
entities.description: A leathery, vicious species of flying eel that the kor hunt.

entities.name: Kazuul
entities.description: A cliff tyrant with ogre slaves.

entities.name: Tajuru
entities.description: Elves of the Kazandu jungle canopies who hone blades.

entities.name: Cliffhaven
entities.description: A dizzying vertical village of the kor.

entities.name: Glasspool
entities.description: A hexagonal lake of perfect placidity near the Glass Haven kor, where something is not right.

entities.name: Chadir
entities.description: A famous navigator who handmade an eyepiece.

events.summary: The kor travel nomadically across Zendikar hunting mikunga on the Roil-churned winds, connecting to their surroundings with lines and hooks.
events.quote: The kor follow a nomadic lifestyle, chasing the winds across Zendikar, hunting the mikunga

relations.quote: The kor are native residents of Zendikar
